limitations: Only already closed Abalone and generated TSP episodes. Full 16-episode verification pending at creation. Recorded outcomes and small source files only; no candidate execution or checkpoint loading.

Abalone-0 candidate first proposal missed the development target; waiting for the second does not identify a confirmation-delay benefit. Abalone-1 candidate actually changes the choice, but the earlier qualifying method has no independent confirmation/audit outcome.

Abalone-1 control confirmation failed its 10% gain requirement (6.7316% observed); its second initial method was ultimately accepted after continued exploration. Independent proposals differ between arms, so matched-task timing is not a single-method ablation.

Abalone-1 control grouped OOF stack fits scaling on all training features and fits/estimates stack weights on the same OOF predictions; its MLP raises an API parameter error and is excluded. Candidate similarly uses full-training feature scaling and in-sample stack weights; its Torch GP and MLP are actually trained, and its internal ExtraTrees reference uses 300 rather than the frozen common 700 trees. These limitations do not replace the independent external audit.

Both TSP candidate repetitions retain their first executed method after also executing the other initial proposal. The added worker evaluations took 252.14745211601257 and 452.51260471343994 seconds. This is observed extra work, not a causal estimate of total paired time differences.

TSP-1 control uses a sequential compiled local search with 12 seconds per instance and 1250 seconds per batch guard. Candidate uses two threads, 20 seconds per instance and a 1150-second guard. Both train only by compiling and short checks; reported training seconds omit development prediction. Candidate compares internally to 6 NN/2-opt starts rather than the common 24; control compares to its own single-start local search. Both external audits use the true frozen reference.
No new policy or product-default decision follows from these two tasks. Results remain development evidence; cross-domain 30% and fresh prospective/runtime requirements are unchanged.
